propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is documented to support REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY but _pai_check_config actively refuses them, making the documented behavior false
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic models are unsupported; the only Bedrock path silently loses prompt caching, retrying transport, timeout configuration, and native structured output
Provider-specific code branches on hardcoded provider-name strings (e.g. resolved.startswith('anthropic')) rather than abstract capability profiles, preventing vendor-agnostic routing
The signed verdict sidecar's model field records only a string that may no longer name the actual provider when routed through a gateway, losing provenance transparency
Retry and timeout configuration parameters do not propagate to the Bedrock code path, leaving production uncontrolled when running on Bedrock
The architectural gap is bridged by adopting pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile capability introspection instead of provider-name matching and string gates
